name: Communication-Aware GRU Training
purpose: Train the four canonical learned objectives under one frozen architecture and paired five-seed protocol.
work_items: run communication-loss lambda sweep on training/development only
freeze selected lambda_link and lambda_outage with exact selection criterion
train trajectory-only objective over five paired seeds
train trajectory+link objective over five paired seeds
train trajectory+outage objective over five paired seeds
train full communication-aware objective over five paired seeds
fit learned uncertainty calibration on development only when used
acceptance_criteria: all four objectives use the same architecture and training schedule except objective terms
all lambda/model selection uses development only
all checkpoints record dataset SHA and commit SHA
normalization statistics are fitted on training data only
forbidden: mixing unmatched old runs into the canonical archive
claiming a one-seed result as final evidence
